title: Looking for real places in Mallworld
content: In my dreams I am in this dream world and for whatever reason I always NEED to find some place from a real world with a nostalgic value. Ofcource it is never there or it is very different than it was in reality. I am very upset I can't find it, anxious, sad, confused and I feel crazy. I feel like these dreams are exhausting me. Does this happen to anyone else?
